Accommodation

Jungle rooms, stream-view stays,
farm suites.

Three room types at the edge of Rajaji forest. All en-suite, all with three Garhwali meals a day, all pet-friendly.

Home / Stay

Three ways to stay

Pick your corner of the forest.

Every room is en-suite, includes three Garhwali meals a day, and opens onto the same quiet hills. The only choice is the view.

What's included with every stay

All meals, all practices, all included.

🍲

3 Garhwali meals a day

Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner. All vegetarian, farm-to-table, local Garhwali cuisine.

🧘

Daily yoga & meditation

Morning Hatha at 6:30 AM, evening Yin at 5:30 PM, and guided meditation. Open to all guests, all levels.

🚕

Rishikesh pickup and drop

Pickup and drop from Rishikesh.

🗺️

Activities

Treks, ashrams, waterfalls, jungle & village walks, a hydroponics farm, and Ayurvedic wellness.
